schemas.description: An array of schema URNs that define the structure of the SCIM resource.

userName.description: The unique identifier for the user. This must be set to the user's primary email address. The `userName` value must be unique across Webex and is used for authentication.

emails.description: A list of the user's email addresses.

organization.description: The unique identifier for the organization.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user in Webex.
